hypothesis: Turtle upper/lower entry channels without separate upper/lower exit channels may reduce premature exits; reversal occurs only on an opposite entry-channel breakout.

corporate_actions.note: Only SFIN cash dividends were verified for a separate sensitivity run. Other symbols and event types remain unverified.

universe: Every TQBR SECID in data/candles/moex_scan/universe_2026-10-30.json with evaluable 1D and 1H candles; the same non-return-selected symbols on all three frames
grid_constraint: One entry length axis, six fixed values plus 55/20 exit-channel control; no retuning after results
baseline: Turtle 55/20: entry channel 55 bars, exit channel 20 bars, same simulator and costs
signal_rule: Close-confirmed breakout above prior entry_length highs or below prior entry_length lows; no separate exit signal; reverse only after opposite entry breakout; all windows exclude current bar and fill at next open
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, corporate actions, short borrow and exchange lots
monthly_regime: ex post only: monthly market return >5% growth, <-5% decline, else sideways if high-low range <=10% of first open, otherwise volatile_mixed
selection: Compare every entry-only variant with 55/20 control on same symbols, candles and costs; retain all outcomes; no automatic paper switch
limitations: intraday windows count bars, not trading days
25% position size differs from current 10% paper setup
historical fills use next open while paper runner fills at the next observed completed close
transaction slippage modeled as cash-cost equivalent, not fill-price shift
no exchange lots or short borrow
dividends and corporate actions not modeled
entry-only positions may remain open for a long time; terminal open position marked to close but not charged hypothetical closing cost
no adaptive stops or volatility sizing
